_comment: Per-source health checks. 'non_empty' paths must exist & be non-empty; 'min_items' asserts array length. This is the canary layer — cheap, runs without the Android SDK. A red canary triggers the (real) Gradle build-time validation before any fix is published.

sources._note: Positive control: open API, no token. Should be OK.
Token-gated API (see VrfSigner.kt). Expected to classify AUTH_TOKEN without the JS-computed token.
